text.tspan: Close-up of Aria's determined face, amber-gold eyes bright,
tongue peeking in concentration, ink smudge on nose, lavender
hair streak glowing softly, blurred Practice Meadow behind her.
Characters: ARIA: human girl 7-8, small stocky build, warm beige
skin with nose freckles, messy chin-length chestnut bob
(#5d4037) with single lavender streak (#c7b8ea), large bright
amber-gold eyes (#ffb300), oversized blush-pink wizard robe
both wrists, ink-smudged fingers, singed robe hem, tiny star
scar on chin, determined concentrated expression with tongue
peeking out. dreamy pastel children's book illustration, soft
blush and mint palette, whisper-thin rounded lines, golden-hour
glow with floating magic motes, ethereal gradients, hand-painted
